title: Probing Neural Combinatorial Optimization Models

layout.note: Two panels side by side, split by a thin vertical rule; each has an encoder region on the left with data flowing upward and a decoder region on the right with data flowing downward, and the red probe cones stick out of the margins into the whitespace.

lesson: Mark the places where a model is read out by touching the exact arrow between two blocks with one saturated-colour glyph (a thin red cone) and a numbered label, on an otherwise pastel anatomy; draw two architectures in the same colour grammar so only the depth placement differs.
